name: Gyakuten! AHE Gakuen ~Mezamero Ore no Semen Cannon~
original_name: 逆転！ＡＨＥ学園～目覚めろ俺の超精液砲～
source:
Takuto's school life became miserable since the day he was targeted for bullying by the girl who had a great power in his school.

One day, when he was walking abstracted on the school yard, he destroyed a small shrine by accident. He was wondering what he should do, then a devil that has been confined to the shrine talked to him. "Do you want to take revenge on these females?"

Though confused, Takuto admitted it and made a contract with the devil. The devil's sprit entered into his body, and he felt the overflow of his sexual desire and energy!

"With this power, I can have my revenge!!"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE108068.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
自从被学校里有权有势的女孩欺负的那天起，拓人的学校生活就变得悲惨了。

有一天，他在学校操场上走着，不小心毁坏了一座小神社。他正想着该怎么办，这时一个被关在神殿里的恶魔对他说话了。“你想给这些女人报仇吗？”

拓人虽然困惑，但还是承认了这一点，并与恶魔签订了契约。恶魔之灵进入了他的身体，他感觉到了自己的性欲和能量的溢出！

“有了这个力量，我就能报仇！！”
